ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF FEBRUARY 24, 2015
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of February 24, 2015.
Minutes 2-24-15 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO RESOLUTION NO. 06-4516 TO ESTABLISH FEES FOR PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT PERMITS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5191 amending Resolution No. 06-4516 to establish fees for planning and development permits.
B-1 Planning Fees Staff Report
B-1 Planning Fees Attachment A City Fee Comparison
B-1 Planning Fees Attachment B Resolution 15-5191
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1381 AND 30
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5192 approving Warrant Register No. 1381 and Resolution No. SA 15-48 approving Warrant Register No. 30.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1381
D-1 Warrants Resolution SA #30
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 14-5171, AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM AND ESTABLISHING THE NUMBER OF AUTHORIZED POSITIONS, MONTHLY SALARY RANGES, HOURLY RATES, FOR CITY EMPLOYEES
It is recommended that the City Council: 1) approve Resolution No. 15-5193 rescinding Resolution No. 14-5171 and amending the comprehensive personnel system and establishing the number of authorized positions, monthly salary ranges, hourly rates, and 2) for City employees.
D-2 Maintenance Worker Staff Report
D-2 Maintenance Worker Attachment A Resolution
D-2 Maintenance Worker Attachment B Job Description
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT NO. 14-1157 BETWEEN THE CITY AND MILAN MRAKICH FOR CODE ENFORCEMENT SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 1 to Professional Services Agreement No. 14-1157 between the City and Contractor and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement.
D-3 Code Enforcement Staff Report
D-3 Code Enforcement Amendment
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND MWH AMERICAS INC. FOR GEOTECHNICAL TESTING AT LA PUENTE PARK
It is recommended that the City Council approve the License Agreement between the City and MWH Americas, Inc. and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement.
D-4 Geo Tech Staff Report
D-4 Geo Tech License Agreement
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A PARK AND STREET USE AGREEMENT WITH LA PUENTE NATIONAL LITTLE LEAGUE NON-PROFIT FOR A CARNIVAL AND PARADE
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Park and Streets Use Agreement for the Youth Coalition Carnival and parade.
D-5 Youth Coalition Staff Report
D-5 Youth Coalition Agreement
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL - None
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this this 5th day of March, 2015
